source: Independently choose visual/motor coordinate reuse in actual native Pong. The arm receives one scalar.
target_selection: No new-holdout selections or fit. Use learned coefficients once available. Overall source-center mechanism was developed using separate earlier SO-101 experiments.
target_primary: Mean longest streak, and proportion reaching ten, with an external fixed release on twenty novel wide-pose stock starts.
target_secondary: Twelve new same-launcher altered-arm starts, and twelve stock starts where a mobile launcher follows the original randomized blade position.
target_inputs: Wrist RGB and five encoder positions/velocities. The motor head and familiar body posture come from earlier hinged donors. The physical setup offers a visible held ball for fourteen to thirty-eight decisions before release.
seed_derivation: PCG64 sequential integers using seed 50244611 plus course index 0,1,2. No target motor practice.
attribution: Test representation transfer. Fixed endpoint matching the native best is an explicit heuristic control. Success cannot establish acquisition of a five-joint motor skill from Pong alone.
